tools.name: inspector_status
tools.description: Connected processes/apps (name, inspector port, pid, directory, warnings) and the number of collected requests. Call this first to learn the app names.

tools.name: list_server_requests
tools.description: HTTP requests made by Node processes (fetch and node:http): app, page, method, URL, status, duration, code location.

app.description: App name (from inspector_status) or inspector port. Omit to include all apps.

url_contains.description: Filter: substring of the outbound request URL

page_contains.description: Filter: substring of the page request that triggered the request, e.g. "/checkout"

last_ms.description: Only requests from the last N milliseconds

since_id.description: Only requests with an id greater than this one

limit.description: Max number of results (default 50, newest first)

tools.name: get_server_request
tools.description: Details of one request: request and response headers, response body with its state, call stack.

tools.name: analyze_server_timeline
tools.description: Timeline analysis of server traffic, per app and per page request: request bursts, sequential (waterfall) vs parallel requests, potential gain from Promise.all (respecting data dependencies), 4xx/5xx errors and dropped connections.

app.description: App name (from inspector_status) or inspector port. Omit to include all apps.

url_contains.description: Filter: substring of the outbound request URL

page_contains.description: Filter: substring of the page request that triggered the request, e.g. "/checkout"

last_ms.description: Only requests from the last N milliseconds

since_id.description: Only requests with an id greater than this one

idle_gap_ms.description: Idle gap that separates bursts, in ms (default 250)

seq_gap_ms.description: Max gap in ms for "started right after the previous one" (default 15)

tools.name: clear_server_requests
tools.description: Clears the request buffer (all apps or one app), e.g. before reproducing a scenario.

app.description: App name (from inspector_status) or inspector port. Omit to include all apps.
